title: Right derived functors identify triangles of termwise split K-injective sequences
statement: Let $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal B)$ be a morphism of ringed spaces with derived direct image $Rg_*:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal B)$ and direct image of modules $g_*$, applied termwise to complexes [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], and let $Q$ denote the localization functors [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $0\to\mathcal I_1^\bullet\xrightarrow{i}\mathcal I_2^\bullet\xrightarrow{p}\mathcal I_3^\bullet\to0$ be a degreewise short exact sequence of cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] which is split in every degree, with each $\mathcal I_k^\bullet$ K-injective [def-pur-kinjective-complex], and let $\delta:\mathcal I_3^\bullet\to\mathcal I_1^\bullet[1]$ be its connecting morphism in $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle]. For a K-injective complex $\mathcal K^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules let $\varphi_{\mathcal K}:Rg_*(Q\mathcal K^\bullet)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q(g_*\mathcal K^\bullet)$ be the identification of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] given by the K-injective resolution $\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal K}$. Then $0\to g_*\mathcal I_1^\bullet\to g_*\mathcal I_2^\bullet\to g_*\mathcal I_3^\bullet\to0$ is a degreewise split short exact sequence of complexes of $\mathcal B$-modules; $\mathcal I_1^\bullet[1]$ is K-injective and $g_*(\mathcal I_1^\bullet[1])=(g_*\mathcal I_1^\bullet)[1]$; and, writing $\delta'$ for the connecting morphism of the image sequence [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle], $\varphi_{\mathcal I_2}\circ Rg_*(Qi)=Q(g_*i)\circ\varphi_{\mathcal I_1}$, $\varphi_{\mathcal I_3}\circ Rg_*(Qp)=Q(g_*p)\circ\varphi_{\mathcal I_2}$ and $\varphi_{\mathcal I_1[1]}\circ Rg_*(\delta)=\delta'\circ\varphi_{\mathcal I_3}$. Consequently the triangle $Rg_*\mathcal I_1^\bullet\to Rg_*\mathcal I_2^\bullet\to Rg_*\mathcal I_3^\bullet\to(Rg_*\mathcal I_1^\bullet)[1]$ with maps $Rg_*(Qi)$, $Rg_*(Qp)$ and $\varphi_{\mathcal I_1}[1]^{-1}\circ\varphi_{\mathcal I_1[1]}\circ Rg_*(\delta)$ is isomorphic through $(\varphi_{\mathcal I_1},\varphi_{\mathcal I_2},\varphi_{\mathcal I_3})$ to the distinguished triangle of the image sequence, hence is distinguished [def-weil-triangulated-category]; in particular $Rg_*$ carries the connecting morphism of the first sequence to that of the image sequence under these identifications.

source.place: Lemma 0152 (canonical delta-functor) together with the K-injective construction of right derived functors

proof.text: Choose degreewise retractions $\pi^n:\mathcal I_2^n\to\mathcal I_1^n$ and sections $s^n:\mathcal I_3^n\to\mathcal I_2^n$ with $\pi^n i^n=\mathrm{id}$, $p^n s^n=\mathrm{id}$, $i^n\pi^n+s^n p^n=\mathrm{id}$. Since $g_*$ is additive [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], applying it to these identities shows that $0\to g_*\mathcal I_1^\bullet\to g_*\mathcal I_2^\bullet\to g_*\mathcal I_3^\bullet\to0$ is degreewise split short exact with retractions $g_*\pi^n$ and sections $g_*s^n$; and $g_*(-d)=-g_*(d)$ gives $g_*(\mathcal I_1^\bullet[1])=(g_*\mathcal I_1^\bullet)[1]$ (elementary). By [lem-weil-pbc-degreewise-split-connecting-morphism] and [lem-weil-pbc-degreewise-split-derived-triangle] the connecting morphism $\delta$ of [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] is $Q$ of the chain map $\pi^{n+1}d^n_{\mathcal I_2}s^n$, with the sign fixed by the cone convention; applied in $\Mod(\mathcal B)$ to the image sequence with the splittings $g_*\pi$, $g_*s$, the same nodes give $\delta'=Q(g_*\pi^{n+1}\circ g_*d^n_{\mathcal I_2}\circ g_*s^n)=Q(g_*(\pi^{n+1}d^n_{\mathcal I_2}s^n))$, since $g_*$ preserves composition.

source.place: Lemma 0152, construction of the canonical delta-functor from a short exact sequence

proof.text: A shift of a K-injective complex is K-injective, since acyclic complexes are stable under shift and $\operatorname{Hom}_{K}(\mathcal N^\bullet,\mathcal I_1^\bullet[1])=\operatorname{Hom}_K(\mathcal N^\bullet[-1],\mathcal I_1^\bullet)$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex] (elementary). For a chain map $u:\mathcal K^\bullet\to\mathcal K'^\bullet$ between K-injective complexes, the definition [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] gives $Rg_*(Qu)=Q(g_*I(u))$ with the functorial K-injective resolutions $\iota_{\mathcal K}:\mathcal K^\bullet\to I(\mathcal K^\bullet)$, which are homotopy equivalences between K-injective complexes and satisfy $I(u)\iota_{\mathcal K}=\iota_{\mathcal K'}u$; $g_*$ carries homotopies to homotopies, and $\varphi_{\mathcal K}$ is the inverse of $Q(g_*\iota_{\mathcal K})$. Hence $\varphi_{\mathcal K'}\circ Rg_*(Qu)=Q(g_*u)\circ\varphi_{\mathcal K}$. Applied to $u=i$, $u=p$ and to the chain map $\pi d_{\mathcal I_2}s:\mathcal I_3^\bullet\to\mathcal I_1^\bullet[1]$ of Step 1 (whose $Q$ is $\delta$), this gives the three asserted identities, the last because $Q(g_*(\pi d_{\mathcal I_2}s))=\delta'$ by Step 1.

source.place: K-injective construction of right derived functors

proof.text: The triangle of the image sequence $g_*\mathcal I_1^\bullet\to g_*\mathcal I_2^\bullet\to g_*\mathcal I_3^\bullet\xrightarrow{\delta'}(g_*\mathcal I_1^\bullet)[1]$ is distinguished in $D(\mathcal B)$ [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle]. By Step 2 the isomorphisms $(\varphi_{\mathcal I_1},\varphi_{\mathcal I_2},\varphi_{\mathcal I_3})$ commute with the first two maps, and with the third map $\varphi_{\mathcal I_1}[1]^{-1}\varphi_{\mathcal I_1[1]}Rg_*(\delta)$ because $\varphi_{\mathcal I_1}[1]\circ(\varphi_{\mathcal I_1}[1]^{-1}\varphi_{\mathcal I_1[1]}Rg_*(\delta))=\varphi_{\mathcal I_1[1]}Rg_*(\delta)=\delta'\varphi_{\mathcal I_3}$. A triangle isomorphic to a distinguished triangle is distinguished [def-weil-triangulated-category], which gives the conclusion.

split_report.summary: No matching project declaration exists in the Lean source, and Mathlib has no theorem identifying a right-derived functor's connecting morphism for a termwise split sequence of K-injectives. The item is split into preservation of the degreewise splitting under the additive functor, represented-complex computation and triangulated preservation by the K-injective right derived functor, and equality of connecting morphisms via the explicit splitting formula.

lean.statement: theorem derivedModuleDirectImage_termwise_split_ses_triangle (g : X ⟶ Y) (S : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ)) (hS : S.ShortExact) (_hSplit : ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty ((S.map (HomologicalComplex.eval (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n)).Splitting)) [S.X₁.IsKInjective] [S.X₂.IsKInjective] [S.X₃.IsKInjective] : ∃ hImage : (S.map ((moduleDirectImage g).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ))).ShortExact, (∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty (((S.map ((moduleDirectImage g).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ))).map (HomologicalComplex.eval (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) n)).Splitting)) ∧ ((derivedModuleDirectImage g).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map S.f) ≫ (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g S.X₂).hom = (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g S.X₁).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (((moduleDirectImage g).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map S.f)) ∧ ((derivedModuleDirectImage g).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map S.g) ≫ (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g S.X₃).hom = (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g S.X₂).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (((moduleDirectImage g).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map S.g)) ∧ ((derivedModuleDirectImage g).map (DerivedCategory.triangleOfSESδ hS) ≫ (derivedModuleDirectImage g).map ((DerivedCategory.Q.commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).inv.app S.X₁) ≫ (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g (S.X₁⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)).hom ≫ (moduleDirectImageLocalizedShiftIso g S.X₁).hom = (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g S.X₃).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.triangleOfSESδ hImage) ∧ (∃ e : derivedModuleDirectImageSplitTriangle g S hS ≅ DerivedCategory.triangleOfSES hImage, e.hom.hom₁ = (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g S.X₁).hom ∧ e.hom.hom₂ = (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g S.X₂).hom ∧ e.hom.hom₃ = (derivedModuleDirectImageKInjectiveIso g S.X₃).hom) ∧ derivedModuleDirectImageSplitTriangle g S hS ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y)))
